title: Afternoon pipeline scrub — Priya
content:
AFTERNOON PIPELINE SCRUB — 2026-12-11
Owner: Priya Nair (AE) — quick personal pad for action items, call outcomes, and 24h follow-ups.

Goals for this sprint (45-60m):
- Clear 6 follow-ups: email or call and set next meeting for at least 3.
- Move 2 SQL/opportunities to next stage (demo scheduled or contract review).
- Triage churn-risk account flagged by CSM (see notes).

Top priority accounts (short notes):
1) HelixHealth — Decision maker: Lina Park (CTO).
   - Last touch: 2026-12-08 discovery w/ Lina + infra eng.
   - Pain: inconsistent latency on existing gen API; wants private deployment for PHI.
   - Next action: Send tailored deployment capability one-pager + ask for availability for 30-min canary plan review.
   - To send by EOD: subject: "HelixHealth private deployment plan — 30-min review?"
   - Desired outcome: commit to POC scope + infra contact.

2) Maplayer (regional logistics) — Champion: Omar Ruiz (Platform lead).
   - Last touch: voicemail 2026-12-10.
   - Note: concerned about unit cost at scale; wants batching guidance + cost estimate.
   - Next action: email with mini-cost model + invite to cost/throughput workshop.

3) Aurora EdTech — Buyer: Sarah Bennett (Head of Product).
   - Showed interest in Dedicated for throughput. Budget check: "tentative Q1".
   - Next action: Quick ROI calc (embed tokens/hr) and attach demo timeslots.

Mid-priority (quick calls, low friction):
- FinchRetail — follow-up on contract redline; legal looped.
- Gravitas Analytics — need to demo embeding search latency (30m alloc).

Cold / reattempt list (2-touch rule today):
- Banya Apps — quick check-in (left voicemail).
- SummitMarkets — renewed interest? send case study + one-liner on fallback routing.

Call/Voicemail snippets (copy & paste adapt):
- Voicemail (short): "Hi <first>, Priya from Redwood Inference — quick one-minute note: we have a low-risk canary setup for private deployments that reduces latency and keeps PHI isolated. Would love 10 minutes to walk you through. My number X. If easier, reply with times or I’ll ping via email. Thanks!"
- Cold call opener: "Hi <first>, I’m Priya on the infra team at Redwood — we help teams cut token spend and bring down tail latency without re-architecting. Have you got 2 minutes?"
- Follow-up email subject ideas:
  * "Small POC plan for <company> — 30 min to review?"
  * "Latency & cost tradeoffs we saw for companies like <peer>"

Meeting scheduling & demo times (to propose):
- Tue/Wed 9:30–11am PT, Thu 1–3pm PT (block these in calendar).
- If client requests APAC times: propose 8–9pm UTC (avoid Friday afternoons).

CRM quick updates (write back into Salesforce after each touch):
- Update stage + next step (email/call/demo).
- Add tag: "cost-model-sent" / "legal-redline" / "cs-hand-off".

Risk flag account — Horizon Care (CS flagged):
- Issue: sudden spike in error rate after model upgrade; they saw degraded quality and are informing procurement.
- My plan: coordinate with Solutions Eng (Ethan) to capture logs + propose rollback window.
- Action: set up 30m triage with SRE/SE today; include CSM + legal if contract concerns raised.

To-do list (timed):
- 0–15m: Quick CRM scrub (close out any outdated tasks) + send 2 follow-up emails (HelixHealth, Maplayer).
- 15–35m: Calls — aim for 3 outbound calls (FinchRetail, Gravitas, Banya Apps).
- 35–50m: Draft and send cost model + attach one-pager (Aurora, Maplayer).
- Last 10m: Log outcomes & set next calendar invite for wins.

Notes for email attachments (one-pager points):
- What Redwood provides: hosted API, Dedicated pools, Private VPC option.
- Key differentiators: predictable latency SLOs, fallback routing, intelligent batching.
- Quick wins: auto-caching prefix + 30% token cost reduction w/ quantization profiles (quote sample numbers).

Open questions / things to check before sending:
- Does HelixHealth need SOC2 + BAA? (if yes, attach compliance packet).
- Maplayer expected TPS at peak — ask for 95th percentile token rate.
- Aurora: confirm current vendor + renewal horizon.

Follow-up templates (short):
- Post-demo: "Thanks for your time today — attached are the action items and the demo recording. Next step: confirm demo infra access window."

- Post-proposal: "Were able to answer all questions? Any blockers on your side for the POC kickoff?"

Personal reminders / energy notes:
- Eat before 3pm. 
- If blocked >20m, escalate to Ethan or Maya for help.

End-of-sprint checklist: 
- Mark wins in CRM, set up follow-up meetings, update opportunity amounts.
- If no replies after 48h, move to 2-week nurture sequence and add to content drip.

Quick metrics to hit this week (for my tracker):
- Calls: 40+
- Qualified opportunities: 6+
- Demos booked: 8+
- POCs initiated: 2

——
Scratch notes (misc):
- Small idea: run a "cost-sensitivity" micro-workshop (30m) for mid-market accounts to show unit economics live. Ask growth ops for calendar template.
- Reminder to update slide deck with new Dedicated latency graph (from infra eng).

End of pad.
(Will copy relevant sections into Salesforce + thread with Solutions Eng after calls.)
